comment: The launch screen, in one place. Every platform draws the same block --
mark, wordmark, version -- centred on black, so the frame the system
puts up and the first frame Qt paints are the same picture.
Numbers are pixels at the 1920x1080 reference the interface is drawn
against; the generator supersamples by renderScale and downsamples.
A layer-list item takes an explicit dp size, so the system frame and
the QML frame are the same size on every screen without either of
them having to guess the other's. Chosen to land near the 59% of the
short edge the reference layout gives a television.

desktop.comment: Core width as a fraction of the viewport's shorter edge.
